t: This drinking fountain in Tanner Street Park in Southwark began as something else. It is a turret from the church of St Olave, converted into a fountain in 1928. The turret was designed by Henry Flitcroft, a major English architect of the second generation of Palladianism. He came from a humble background and began as a joiner. After he fell from a scaffold at Burlington House, Lord Burlington noticed his talent with a pencil, and Flitcroft became his draughtsman and assistant.
